name: Tombstone
review:
Tombstone is the 2019 original that started the series. Three-row Outlaw Wilds on reels 2 to 4 nudge into view, gaining +1 per step. A Sheriff badge on reel 1 and a Marshal badge on reel 5 award three Justice Spins with sticky wilds.

Three scatters trigger ten Gunslinger Spins, where the wild multipliers don't reset. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with an 11,456x cap and a 96.19% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
